run_vision_annotation_job: run a VisionAnnotationJob to spin up HITs for turkers to annotate visual scenes with instance segmentation masks
create_vision_annotation_job: create a VisionAnnotationJob instance with a batch_id, timestamp, list of scenes, and optional timeout value
upload_annotated_scenes_to_s3: upload vision annotation results to the droidlet-hitl S3 bucket and save locally in the HITL_TMP_DIR
launch_mephisto_hits: launch a batch of Mephisto HITs by updating the annotation config and running run_annotation_with_qual.py
retrieve_mephisto_annotation_data: retrieve annotated scene data from Mephisto units and extract instance segmentation tags into output scenes
